contract.label: Checkbox
contract.summary: A checkbox styled as a small box, with a tick when selected and a dash when indeterminate.
contract.purpose: Turn one option on or off, or pick any number from a short visible set. The box rests on an opaque face — `outline-surface`, the outline Button's — so an empty box keeps its edge on a tinted row, a filled table header or the `muted` page body, and in dark it is the same `input` lift every other field has.
useWhen: One independent yes/no setting that is saved with the form around it — a consent, an opt-in.
Any number of options from a short set that should all be visible at once, each with its own label.
Row selection in a `table`: a header box selects every row and shows `indeterminate` while only some are selected.
dontUseWhen: Exactly one option is chosen — that is `radio-group`.
The set is long or needs searching — that is `multi-select`.
The setting takes effect the moment it is flipped rather than on submit — that is `switch`.

parts.name: Checkbox
parts.description: Checkbox root. Selected shows a tick; pass indeterminate (or use a CheckboxGroup parent) for the dash. inline-flex, so a centred cell centres it without a wrapper.

requires: A visible label on every box, wired through `label` so the text toggles it; a box with no visible text, such as a table's select-all, carries an `aria-label`.
`aria-invalid` on the control when validation fails, paired with a `FieldError` that names what is wrong.
forbids: Re-tinting the resting face with a `bg-*` class so the box reads on a row or the page body. The face is already opaque in light and the `input` lift in dark on every surface, so there is no `surface` prop to set and nothing to override.
Hand-drawing the checked or indeterminate look — both come from the `data-checked` and `data-indeterminate` attributes, with the glyph from the primitive's own indicator.
rules: **The face is opaque by default, on every surface.** An unchecked box paints `outline-surface` — white in light, the `input/30` lift in dark — so it reads on a `destructive-subtle` row, a filled table header, a selected row and the `muted` page body without any prop. Unlike `input` or `select` there is no `surface="page"`: a 16px box has no text or size to read by, so transparency never works for it, and a white face has no surface where it looks wrong.

behavior.error: Invalid means `aria-invalid` on the box plus an inline `FieldError` — a required consent that blocks submit says so next to the box.

requirements: Every box has an accessible name — its label, or an `aria-label` where no text is shown.
Colour is never the only state signal; checked and indeterminate carry a glyph, and invalid carries a message.

examples: `<Label className="flex items-center gap-2"><Checkbox /> Email me peak demand alerts</Label>` — the label text toggles the box.
`<Checkbox aria-label="Select all meters" checked={allSelected ? true : someSelected ? "indeterminate" : false} />` in a table header.
antiPatterns: A column of unlabeled boxes whose meaning sits only in a header cell the screen reader never links to them.
A box given `bg-background` or `bg-card` to show on a tinted row — the default face already does, and in dark `background` would sink it below the cards beside it.
